edits.new: For this trial, the hierarchy node "coffeechain" means the #coffeechain community on Nostr, where people share coffee experiences and exchange morning greetings. Use this same meaning for every post. Use the complete post to judge how much of its meaning concerns this topic; do not redefine the node's topic from each post's other subjects.
edits.old: Use the complete post to interpret the hierarchy node title as it applies to that post.
